notes: Official Attentive V2 OpenAPI spec was used as the source.
The CLI normalizes the spec to bearer-token auth only because the public spec also advertises OAuthFlow alternatives with scopes that are not part of this read-first generated CLI.
Live vendor behavior was not verified because no Attentive credentials were available.

novel_features.name: Segment Directory
novel_features.description: List and filter Attentive segments by name, external ID, update timestamp, cursor, and page size for agent-readable campaign audience discovery.

novel_features.name: Segment External Lookup
novel_features.description: Resolve a segment by its external ID so agents can inspect the current Attentive audience object before changing memberships.

novel_features.name: Bulk Job Status
novel_features.description: Check asynchronous bulk ingestion jobs and surface completion metadata plus downloadable result URLs when Attentive provides them.
